title: Estimating Worksheet — Annual Plan Fees, Activation and Survey Fees and Entry Thresholds of the Building Automation Service Plans
content:
# Estimating Worksheet — Annual Plan Fees, Activation and Survey Fees and Entry Thresholds of the Building Automation Service Plans

The estimating desk builds a quote for the Building Automation Service Plans from the following per-tier figures: the annual plan fee before per-point and gateway fees, the one-time fee to commission the plan and the remote connection, whether a site survey of the controls system is required before the plan is quoted, the survey fee (credited against the activation fee when the plan starts), the oldest controller generation the tier supports expressed as the earliest model year, and whether the plan is sold only alongside an active maintenance agreement at the same site.

| Tier | Annual plan fee (USD per year) | Activation fee (USD, one time) | Site survey required | Site survey fee (USD) | Oldest supported controller generation (model year) | Sold only alongside maintenance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | 1450 | 350 | no | 0 | 2008 | no |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | 3900 | 650 | yes | 450 | 2010 | no |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | 7800 | 950 | yes | 650 | 2012 | yes |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | 13500 | 1250 | yes | 650 | 2014 | yes |
| Remote Optimization Plan | 24500 | 1850 | yes | 950 | 2016 | yes |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | 62000 | 3500 | yes | 1450 | 2018 | yes |

Worksheet lines:

- Line A, annual plan fee: the figure in the second column, before any per-point or gateway fee.
- Line B, activation fee: the one-time commissioning fee in the third column, from which a survey fee already paid is credited when the plan starts.
- Line C, survey fee: the figure in the fifth column, payable where the tier requires a survey; the Controls Help Desk Subscription requires none and carries 0 USD.
- Entry thresholds: the model-year column is the oldest controller generation the tier supports; the last column states which tiers are sold only alongside maintenance at the same site.

Worked illustration (hypothetical): a site surveyed for the Alarm Monitoring Plan pays the 450 USD survey fee; when the plan starts the activation fee of 650 USD is charged less that 450 USD already paid, leaving 200 USD of activation fee on the first invoice.
